edits.prompt: Keep this portrait mobile design, palette, typography, idea field, header and gesture bar. Correct these UX details only: make the Setup needed badge amber with a warning/shield icon, not green. Make the send circle gray and clearly disabled while AI setup is missing. Keep the Set up AI action and editable idea text. Replace the lower combined Build manually card with TWO distinct compact navigable rows: 'Build manually' / 'No AI needed', and 'Use an offline starter' / 'Notes, tasks, habits and more'. They must be visually separate choices with chevrons, not one merged option. Do not add an attachment icon or any new capability. Preserve example prompts and title. One single screen.

Keep this portrait Sea blue mobile plan screen, typography, layout and controls. Change ONLY the three blue checkmark squares beside planned features into small neutral gray 'Planned' labels or neutral list icons. They are proposed features and must not look like completed checks. In the Daily expenses row change 'Add a cost and category.' to 'Add a cost and note.' so the separate optional 'Add categories' suggestion remains meaningful. Keep all other rows, tabs, editable chevrons, optional toggle, Update plan and Build app action. Do not add unsupported controls. One single screen.

Edit this ideal mobile UI concept only in the specified ways. Preserve its typography, Sea blue palette, spacing, before/after review, checks panel, and Preview/Apply/Discard actions exactly. Remove the entire bottom message composer, including the paperclip and send button. The review page has NO composer and NO attachment feature. Let the Apply change and Discard proposal area sit above the bottom Android gesture inset with comfortable whitespace. Add a small clear back arrow at the upper left of the project header to return to Apps without changing the project title/icon. Do not add any new button, navigation tab or capability. This must remain a single portrait high-fidelity Android screen.

additionalScreens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity ideal portrait mobile Android screen for BuildAI. Aspect 9:20, screen fills the image, no montage, no presentation board, no perspective. Use the input image only as the shared visual design-system reference: consistent scale, crisp Inter-like type, 20dp margins, 8pt rhythm, 48dp targets, 16dp radii, precise hierarchy and clean typography. Improve spacing and remove heavy borders and redundant oversized controls. Flat surfaces, NO gradients/glass/3D; readable accurate English; status bar 9:41 and bottom gesture bar. Calm mobile UX inspired by polished conversation and building apps, without copying their branding. Existing functionality only. No accounts, no unsupported file import/attachments/calendar/reminders. Primary actions clear, destructive actions secondary. Except the two root libraries, no Apps/Chats bottom bar. Project workspaces have Chat/Plan/Preview tabs, no mode switch.
